chunks: 38 – Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Sinān, Abū ʿĪsā. His lineage and his ḥadīth are confused.
ai.seo_question: Who is Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Sinān in Shia biographical dictionaries?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of al-Du'afa (The Weak) identifies Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Sinān, known as Abū ʿĪsā. The narrator is characterized by having a confused or unstable lineage (nasab) and a confused transmission of hadith (hadith), indicating issues in his reliability or the clarity of his reports.
